environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The PostgreSQL RDS instance (db.r5.large) is accessed via the app_user role which has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in the assets schema. The service is exposed through an ALB with a simple path-based routing rule forwarding /api/* to the target group. No additional middleware or query filtering is applied. The ECS task role has standard CloudWatch and ECR permissions. Security groups allow inbound on port 443 from the ALB and outbound to the RDS instance on port 5432.

config.db_user_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
config.network: private subnet, sg allows 5432 outbound to RDS sg
